params.body:
## Why

Ilse, 2026-09-17: "Dat zat in een dropdown bij het aanmaken van een biedingswagen. Daar had je de keuze: iedereen mag bieden, eigen handelaars of alleen dealers." The app Delta ran until the cutover had that dropdown; the export of 2026-06-12 we built on only had it in a dead modal (`export/form.blade.php`), so every bidding since 2026-09-15 was written with `bidding_type` NULL (12 rows), which the readers treat as "everyone". Production before the cutover: 1,767 x everyone, 16 x own merchants, 4 x dealers only. Decision: all three come back, default "iedereen mag bieden".

## What changed

- **Form** (`VehicleForm`, Type step, only for a bidding vehicle): a select "Wie mag bieden" with the three existing labels (`export.bidding_all|dealers|merchants`), default everyone, validated `in:0,1,2`. The form posts `bidding_type` itself; `OwnStockService::finalizeCreate` and `finalizeEdit` write it to `export_vehicles` through `biddingTypeFor()` instead of relying on `request()->bidding_type`. Once a bid exists the value is shown read-only (`ExportVehicle::biddingTypeLocked`) and every save path keeps what stands.
- **Observer / controllers**: the three copies of `getExportVehicleData` fall back to the existing type, else everyone, never NULL.
- **List** "Mijn aangeboden wagens": row and phone card show the type as a quiet `ui-chip` only when it is not everyone; documents-only keeps its label.
- **Migration** `2026_09_17_100000`: `UPDATE ... SET bidding_type = 0 WHERE NULL`, column `NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`. Model default and `normaliseBiddingType()` match.
- **Translations** nl/fr/en/de: `export.who_may_bid`, `who_may_bid_hint`, `bidding_type_locked`.
- **Docs**: R B1-1.8 rewritten to the decision (stand `klant`); finding X-01 (`2026-09-11-type-bieding-...`) resolved; new finding `2026-09-17-delta-productiecode-nieuwer-dan-export.md` (Delta's live code was newer than our export; what else "used to work"?).

## Tests

`BiddingTypeChoiceTest` (9 tests): the form posts the type and it lands on the bidding; default everyone; edit changes it while no bid exists; read-only (and unchangeable) once a bid exists; select shows only on the Type step of a bidding vehicle; unknown type refused; `MailHelper::sendMails` picks recipients per type (existing behaviour, pinned for the first time); column NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; list chip only for 1/2. Mutation-checked.

Ran: BiddingTest, BiddingFunnelTest, ExportListPhoneCardTest, ExportListAccessTest, VehicleForm*Test, OwnVehicleAuthorizationTest, LanguageParityTest, RulesCoverageTest, RulesIdentityTest, StylesheetSyntaxTest, AlpineExpressionTest, HandlerWiringTest, CompiledViewsTest (93 tests, 1 pre-existing incomplete) and SmokeTest filtered on export/ownvehicle (55 tests): green.

## Screenshots

Form (free, locked) at 1440 and the list at 1440/390 in `.playwright-mcp/bidding-type/` of the worktree (not committed).

No hot shared files touched (`refresh.css`, `ui.php`, `app.blade.php`, `_wagen_rij.blade.php`, `SmokeTest.php` unchanged). `13-s3-car-pass.md` untouched; the vehicle-form change is one block after the type tiles, before the chassis row.
params.title: Bidding: 'Wie mag bieden' is back on the bidding vehicle form
